A '''flowfit chair''' was a type of furniture. The [[Rhysode Room]], a meeting room in the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], contained flowfit chairs arranged around a [[roo-wood]] serenity table.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
